title: Patron Journey event draft v1 (Festival Forecaster -> Organizer Worker)
description: Smallest payload that creates an Odoo event through the Organizer Worker. The owner is NEVER in the payload: it always comes from the signed-in session. Server-side validation in src/drafts.ts is authoritative.

start.description: Local wall clock in `timezone` (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]) or ISO 8601 with Z/offset.

end.description: Same format as start; must be after start.

description.description: Plain text; blank lines become paragraphs.

tags.description: Free-form; missing Odoo event.tag records are auto-created.

image.description: https URL (fetched by the Worker at create time), data:image/(png|jpeg|webp|gif);base64,..., or raw base64. Max 5 MB decoded.

tickets.description: Extra ticket types on top of the always-created free General Admission. Price is forced to 0 by the Worker; seats_max = capacity. Names are kept exactly as given, e.g. "GA – Pay at Door $199".

price.description: Accepted for the forecast's reference; ignored (Odoo price is always 0).

lineup.description: Acts with set times (same format/timezone as start). Each named act becomes an event.track and must fall inside start..end. Rows with a blank or missing name are skipped; if no named acts remain, one default track named after the event spans start..end.

forecast.description: Opaque simulator output (budget, P&L, Monte Carlo). Stored in D1 with the draft only; never sent to Odoo.
